womensHealth.title: Women's Health
womensHealth.description: Pelvic floor physiotherapy for strengthening muscles after childbirth, surgery, menopause, or other factors.

postSurgery.title: Post-Surgery Physiotherapy
postSurgery.description: Supports healing and restores function after surgeries such as knee, spine, hip, shoulder, wrist, and ankle.

tmj.title: TMJ Disorder Treatment
tmj.description: Reduces jaw pain and improves movement with exercises, massage, and heat/cold therapy.

vertigo.title: Vertigo Treatment
vertigo.description: Personalized exercises to improve balance, stability, and reduce dizziness.

sports.title: Sports Physiotherapy
sports.description: Rehabilitation for a safe return to sport and prevention of future injuries.

acupuncture.title: Acupuncture & Dry Needling
acupuncture.description: Treats physical conditions, releases trigger points, and restores muscle function with fine needle techniques.

spine.title: Spinal Physiotherapy
spine.description: Diagnoses and treats spinal movement problems with mobility exercises and targeted treatments.

chiropractic.title: Chiropractic
chiropractic.description: Spinal manipulation and related treatments to reduce back, neck, and head pain and mechanical musculoskeletal problems.
